sections.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you begin your DanceSing journey.

items.question: Do I need any prior dance or singing experience?
items.answer: Absolutely not. DanceSing is designed for all levels — from complete beginners to advanced practitioners. Our instructors provide clear guidance at every step.

items.question: What equipment do I need?
items.answer: All you need is a device with internet access and a bit of space to move. Some programs may recommend specific props, but these are always optional and affordable.

items.question: Can I access classes on my phone or tablet?
items.answer: Yes! Our platform is fully optimised for mobile devices. Download our app for the best experience, or access everything through your browser.

items.question: How does the free trial work?
items.answer: Your free trial gives you full Pro access for 14 days — no credit card required. At the end of the trial, choose the plan that suits you or continue with our free Starter tier.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel at any time with no penalties. Your access continues until the end of the billing period.
